title: A full subleading scalar-recentering window remains unbounded below and fails Mosco weak liminf

recentering_window.necessary_upper_location: If inf spec(K_N(a)) is bounded below uniformly, then a_N<=E_N+O(1). K1484 therefore forces a_N<=6gC_N^2-g sigma_N+O(N)
recentering_window.excluded_window: For any fixed epsilon>0, every scalar sequence satisfying a_N>=6gC_N^2-(g-epsilon)sigma_N eventually has inf spec(K_N(a))<=-epsilon sigma_N+O(N), hence tends to minus infinity
recentering_window.weak_trial: The K1484 normalized Ritz eigenvectors converge weakly to the nonzero vacuum vector 1/sqrt(2)
recentering_window.mosco_failure: On the same Ritz vectors the K_N(a) form values tend to minus infinity throughout the excluded window, contradicting weak Mosco liminf for every finite semibounded limiting form on the fixed Gaussian Hilbert space
recentering_window.projective_case: The exact projective shift a_N=6gC_N^2 is the epsilon<g special case already excluded by K1480; the new result excludes every shift that recovers less than g sigma_N by a fixed positive fraction
recentering_window.ceiling: The boundary is necessary and one-sided. It does not exclude a_N=E_N+O(1), shifts at or below 6gC_N^2-g sigma_N+O(N), singular dressings, non-Gaussian measures, changed representations or unbounded-below strong-resolvent behavior
